title: Virtual Compute: evt refund
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. A requested amount exceeding the applicable refund limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund methods, require at least refund minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Evidence — refund consent

For refund, The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, customer request reference, original source reference, status, compute contract reference. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, customer request reference, original source reference, compute contract reference.

## Recorded accounting basis

All posted financial events through the frozen handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. The receivable is determined by those signed postings.

## Account meaning

Signed customer debt: service charges, upward adjustments, returned payments and refunds increase it; payments and credits decrease it.

superseded_clauses: Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.
The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.
